node.title: Fixed-background GRS shells pay bounded background polarity
node.statement: In an FPC5 cell with 0<=u<=b, each required u-set R gives a GRS syndrome shell with D=d+ell-1 and support cap d-ell. Summing the exact fixed-R singleton or positive-Johnson bound gives |F|<=binom(b,u) in the injective D>=N branch, and |F|<=binom(b,u) N ell/[d^2-N(d-ell)] when the denominator is positive. Hence either branch is polynomial whenever min(u,b-u) is bounded. The relation J_bg=b J_fix-Nu(b-u) shows that this complements rather than repeats joint-background Johnson.
